user.title: Pair the learning companion (prototype)
user.description: Development only. Pair with the separate learning-bridge key, not the Codex key. Phone learning is opt-in after pairing; no Echo adapter is included.

error.cannot_connect: Pairing could not be verified. Check the address and learning-bridge key.

abort.already_configured: This learning bridge is already configured.

init.title: Experimental phone learning
init.description: Off by default. Choose your ordinary Wyoming Whisper engine, NOT Voice Match. It processes speech to recognise yes, pause and status; phrase wording is not checked. Use the dedicated learning STT and learning agent together in a separate assistant. Spoken consent is limited to your own assigned profile. Global sentence triggers may intercept; intercepted recordings are discarded. Native task binding is experimental and requires version testing. No accountless Echo support.

error.invalid_stt_source: Select an existing ordinary Wyoming Whisper STT engine, not the learning engine.
